hypothesis: Jerome (call of 19 Oct 2026, 00:29-00:33 and 01:14): follow the local field of each site, the exact posterior E[a_i | x_t] (here its sign probability), along diffusion time. At long times it is zero by symmetry; at speciation the sites commit to a well. Do they commit one after another, a front or avalanche along the chain, or all at once under one effective field? On a chain with finite correlation length there is no global sign: the field is made of domains separated by kinks. Our expectation, stated before the run: each domain commits as a block (almost all at once inside it), longer domains earlier, the sites next to a kink last; no propagation across kinks.
design: Laptop, TRUE kernel only (no learning). Cells T0.2_h1 (xi = 19.5 sites) and T0.3_h1 (xi = 6.1), L = 256, 32 exact stationary chains each (rng_for('e53-chains', cell)). One exact Ornstein-Uhlenbeck path per chain on 80 levels t_k geometrically spaced in [0.02, 4] (successive exact transitions, rng_for('e53-path', cell)); read backwards, an OU path has the law of a reverse-diffusion trajectory driven by the exact score. At every level, grid BP with the true kernel and its stationary initial law (401 points on [-8, 8], `return_sign_prob`): p_i = P(a_i > 0 | x_t), polarisation m_i = 2 p_i - 1. Site i is committed at t_k if m_i sign(a_i) >= 0.5; its commitment time tau_i is the largest t_k such that it is committed at every level t_j <= t_k (0 if not committed at the smallest level). Domains: maximal runs of one sign of the clean chain, interior (not touching an end), length >= 8 sites; core sites at least two sites from both ends of the domain, edge sites the two end sites; only sites with |a_i| >= 0.5 enter tau statistics.

predeclared_predictions.P1: All at once inside a domain: at both cells, the median over domains of the within-domain standard deviation of core-site tau is below 0.25 times the standard deviation over domains of the domain tau (median of its core-site tau).
predeclared_predictions.P2: Longer domains commit earlier along the generation (at larger t): Spearman(domain tau, domain length) > 0.4 at both cells.
predeclared_predictions.P3: The sites next to a kink commit last: the median over domains of (median core tau - median edge tau) is positive, and the difference is positive in at least 75% of domains, at both cells.

predeclared_analysis: tools/core/read_e53.py on outputs/E53/sites.csv (one row per chain and site: a_i, tau_i, domain id, domain length, role core/edge/other) with the definitions above; pooled over the 32 chains per cell. A cell with fewer than 20 qualifying domains reports 'unresolved' for every prediction.

seeds.confirmatory: rng_for('e53-chains', cell) and rng_for('e53-path', cell); deterministic given them
